# fp1-tuplets

**Origin:** authored for this repository, generated byte for byte by a
script and checked in as bytes. Not a third-party work.
**Licence:** MIT, as with the rest of the repository.

## Why it is here

Lines of K=5, 7, 11 and 47, whose onsets do not land on any power-of-two
grid (a 384-per-measure store cannot hold a fifth).

An fp1 fixture, chosen for what it exercises in the algorithm rather than as
music. It is not a template for a good chart.
